title: h3spec HTTP/3 Server Conformance Pipeline Work Item
summary: Add an advisory h3spec pipeline for the local HTTP/3 server with lifecycle scripts, stdout/stderr capture, parsed JSON results, Markdown triage, CI dispatch, and RFC 9114/RFC 9204 failure mapping.
planned_changes:
- Add a server lifecycle script for the local HTTP/3 sample server.
- Add a repo-local h3spec acquisition path under `.artifacts/tools` for hosts without a global h3spec binary.
- Add an h3spec runner script that captures stdout, stderr, metadata, requested match/skip filters, parsed JSON, and Markdown.
- Add a parser that maps h3spec HTTP/3 failures to RFC 9114 and QPACK failures to RFC 9204.
- Add selected-case and no-selected-cases classification so focused match runs cannot be mistaken for conformance passes when the tool selects zero cases.
- Add an opt-in CI workflow that runs plan-only by default and supports manual live h3spec execution.
- Add a checked-in triage report template and requirement-home proof.
out_of_scope: fixing protocol failures discovered by h3spec
making h3spec a required pull-request gate
claiming complete RFC 9114 or RFC 9204 support from h3spec output alone
owning protocol requirements inside the INT harness lane
verification_plan: Run solution build, run the requirement-home tests for REQ-QUIC-INT-0032, run the h3spec runner in plan-only mode, run the parser against sample failing and no-selected-cases h3spec stdout files, run the repo-local acquisition path where the platform supports it, run focused live h3spec match probes where locally available, run PowerShell parser checks where available, and run core SpecTrace validation.
